title: Canonical divided powers on ideals in rational algebras
statement: Let $B$ be a commutative ring equipped with a unital ring homomorphism $\mathbf Q\to B$, and let $I\subseteq B$ be an ideal. There is an ordinary divided-power structure $\delta$ on $I$ [def-sfb-ordinary-divided-power-structure] whose values, viewed in $B$, satisfy $\delta_n(x)=(n!)^{-1}x^n$ for every $x\in I$ and integer $n\geq0$, where $(n!)^{-1}$ is the image in $B$ of the rational number $1/n!$.
